title: Count Inversions
statement: A ranking list is given. An inversion is a pair of positions i and j with i before j but value i greater than value j. Count the inversions.
input_format: The first line contains n. The second line contains n integers.

examples.explanation: The inversions are (2,1), (4,1) and (4,3), so the answer is 3.

hints: Checking every pair is too slow for 200000 values.
While merging two sorted halves, every time an element from the right half is taken first, it forms inversions with all remaining left elements.
The count can be about 2 times 10 to the power 10, which needs 64-bit integers.
